From Scattered to Structured: A Vision for Automating Architectural Knowledge Management
Deep Learning for Code Search: A Study
papers.abstract: We present a neural embedding approach for code search that jointly encodes natural language queries and source code snippets into a shared vector space. On a benchmark of over 50,000 query-code pairs, our model improves mean reciprocal rank (MRR) by 12% over prior retrieval baselines.

papers.title: A Survey of Program Repair Techniques
papers.abstract: This survey categorizes automated program repair techniques into search-based, semantic, and learning-based approaches, and compares how each is evaluated across common benchmarks. We identify a lack of standardized evaluation protocols as a recurring threat to validity across the surveyed studies.

papers.title: A Survey of Deep Learning Frameworks for Image Classification
papers.abstract: We compare convolutional and transformer-based architectures for image classification across five standard benchmarks, reporting accuracy, throughput, and parameter counts for each framework.

papers.title: Automated Program Repair: An Industrial Case Study (Workshop Report)
papers.abstract: We report on deploying an automated program repair tool inside a single company's CI pipeline over six months, describing patch acceptance rates and developer feedback. Presented at an internal engineering workshop; not independently peer-reviewed.

papers.title: Grammar-Based Program Synthesis for Automated Repair
papers.abstract: We propose a grammar-guided synthesis approach that constrains the search space of candidate patches using a language-specific context-free grammar, and evaluate it against existing benchmarks for automated repair.
